title: Graphic Designer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a creative
**Graphic Designer**
to develop visual communication for our events and brands. This is a priority opening for someone who can translate briefs into effective digital and print designs while maintaining brand consistency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design social media creatives, digital advertisements, email banners, and website graphics.
* Create event brochures, invitations, presentations, signage, and promotional material.
* Develop visual concepts that communicate campaign messages clearly.
* Adapt approved designs across different sizes, formats, and platforms.
* Prepare final files, incorporate feedback, and manage design deadlines.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator or equivalent design software.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong layout, typography, and visual communication skills.
* Understanding of image resolution, colour modes, and digital and print output requirements.
* Ability to follow brand guidelines and interpret creative briefs.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple assignments.

**Preferred (Nice To Have)**

* Experience designing for events, exhibitions, or lifestyle brands.
* Familiarity with InDesign, Figma, or presentation design.
* Basic motion graphics or video-editing skills.
* Immediate availability to join.

title: Mould designer
description:
**Company Description**
Bharati Technologies is a growing technology-oriented manufacturing company committed to precision engineering and quality-driven solutions. The organization focuses on delivering reliable products and services to customers across various industrial sectors, with a strong emphasis on innovation and practical problem-solving. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, collaborate across functions, and continuously improve processes and designs. The company values integrity, technical excellence, and a safe, inclusive work environment that supports professional development. Joining Bharati Technologies offers opportunities to work on challenging projects and build a long-term career in engineering and manufacturing.
  
**Role Description**
The Mould Designer will be responsible for designing injection moulds, die-casting moulds, and related tooling components for manufacturing applications. Day-to-day tasks include interpreting drawings and specifications, developing 2D and 3D designs, selecting appropriate materials, and ensuring designs meet functional, safety, and quality requirements. The role involves collaborating with production, quality, and procurement teams to optimize mould designs for manufacturability, cost efficiency, and durability. The Mould Designer will also participate in design reviews, update documentation, and support troubleshooting of mould-related issues during trials and production. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Vasai.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of mould design principles, tooling concepts, and manufacturing processes related to injection moulding and/or die casting.
* Proficiency in CAD software (such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar) for 2D drafting and 3D modelling of moulds and components.
* Understanding of materials, tolerances, fits, and machining methods used in precision mould and tool manufacturing.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, customer specifications, and technical standards.
* Good problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze design issues and propose practical, cost-effective solutions.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams on design changes and production feedback.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Tool & Die Engineering, or a related discipline; formal training in mould design is an advantage.
* Prior experience in mould design, tool room, or precision engineering is preferred, but candidates with strong fundamentals and willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
* Attention to detail, commitment to quality, and readiness to work on-site in Vasai in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

title: Art Intern
description:
**Role Overview**
:

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Design Intern to support our design team in creating engaging visual content for digital marketing campaigns. The intern will assist in developing creative assets while ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and audience preferences.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Design Creation:

* Develop static creative design layouts for marketing materials including social media posts, email campaigns, and other digital assets.
* Assist the team in creating visually engaging content for various digital platforms.

2. Research & Trend Analysis:

* Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, and industry best practices to create innovative and effective artwork.
* Conduct research on target audience demographics, preferences, and behavior to support effective visual communication.

3. Time Management:

* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks while adhering to internal turnaround times (TATs).

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills:**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
* Basic knowledge of design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or Figma.
* Strong creativity and attention to detail.
* Understanding of social media design formats and digital content.
* Ability to take feedback and work collaboratively in a team environment.

**What You’ll Gain:**

* Hands-on experience in graphic design for digital marketing campaigns.
* Exposure to real client projects and diverse creative requirements.
* Opportunity to build a strong design portfolio.
* Learning from experienced designers and creative teams.

title: Graphic designer
description:
**Company Description**
 Prometteur is a leading global systems integrator and business transformation consulting organisation. Prometteur helps companies innovate and transform by leveraging its unique insights, differentiated services, and flexible partnering models. The company is among the Top mobile application development companies in India, and also a pioneer in web application development and Automation Testing. Prometteur has gained the trust of more than 300 offshore clients from 30\+ countries worldwide and has become a trustworthy software partner.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About Prometteur**
**Prometteur is a people\-centric global technology and business transformation company that believes in innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We provide employees with opportunities to work on cutting\-edge mobile, web, and automation technologies for clients across 30\+ countries. With a supportive and growth\-driven work culture, we encourage creativity, skill development, and career progression. Trusted by 300\+ global clients, Prometteur offers a dynamic environment where employees can build impactful digital solutions and grow professionally.**
**Job Title**
**Graphic Designer**
**Experience: 3\+ Years**
**Employment Type: Full\-time**
**About The Role**
**We are looking for a highly creative and visually driven Graphic Designer who can turn ideas, problems and business requirements into compelling visual solutions.**
**Who can think creatively, understand the problem behind a brief, explore different possibilities and deliver a strong final outcome.**
**The ideal candidate combines strong visual design, creative thinking, visual storytelling and UX/design thinking. They should be comfortable working across different types of creative challenges and should have the judgement to decide what visual approach, format and tool is best for the problem at hand.**
**We care more about the quality of your thinking and the final outcome**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**What You'll Do**
**Creative \& Concept Development**
* Translate briefs, ideas, business objectives, and abstract concepts into strong visual directions.
* Develop original creative concepts rather than simply following existing design patterns.
* Explore multiple visual approaches and identify the strongest direction for a given problem.
* Create compelling visual storytelling through composition, typography, imagery, colour, motion, and other visual elements.
* Bring fresh ideas and creative perspectives to projects across brand, product, marketing, and digital communication.
* Challenge conventional approaches when a better creative solution exists.


**Visual \& Experience Design**
* Create high\-quality visual assets across digital and brand touchpoints.
* Apply strong principles of typography, composition, hierarchy, colour, spacing, imagery, and visual balance.
* Consider the audience, context, purpose, and user behaviour behind every design decision.
* Apply UX thinking to ensure that designs are not only visually strong but also clear, intuitive, and effective.
* Collaborate with UX, product, marketing, content, and development teams where required.
* Adapt creative concepts across different formats and platforms without losing their core idea or quality.


**Ownership \& Execution**
* Take ownership of projects from initial idea through final delivery.
* Present and explain creative decisions clearly.
* Respond to feedback without losing the core creative intent.
* Manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining a high standard of creative quality.
* Maintain attention to detail across final deliverables.
* Continuously experiment with new creative approaches, technologies, and workflows.


**Tools \& Workflow**
**We are tool\-agnostic.**
**We do not require strong proficiency in any particular design software.**
**You may use Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Affinity, Procreate, After Effects, AI tools, or any other tools you are comfortable with.**
**What matters to us is:**
**Your thinking → Your creative direction → Your execution → The final outcome.**
**The ability to learn and adapt to new tools is more important than expertise in a specific software.**
**AI \& Emerging Creative Tools**
* Use AI and emerging creative technologies where they can improve ideation, exploration, experimentation, or productivity.
* Know how to combine AI\-assisted workflows with human creative judgement.
* Maintain originality, quality, brand consistency, and design intent when using AI.
* Be willing to experiment with new creative technologies and workflows.


**Portfolio**
**A strong portfolio is mandatory.**
**We are particularly interested in portfolios that demonstrate:**
* Strong creative concepts
* Original visual thinking
* Visual storytelling
* Branding and identity
* Digital experiences
* UX/design thinking
* Campaign or communication design
* Ability to solve different kinds of creative problems
* Strong attention to detail and quality of execution


**We want to understand how you think, not just how polished your final designs look.**
**Qualification**
* 3\+ years of professional experience in graphic/visual design or a related creative role.
* Degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Junior Motion Graphic Designer & Video Editor
company: Eggfirst Advertising and Digital Marketing Agency -  Specialist in Tier 2/3 & Rural markets of India
description:
**Company Description** 
 Eggfirst Advertising and Digital Marketing Agency is India’s leading semi\-urban and rural specialist full\-service advertising agency, with a strong focus on Tier 2/3 and rural markets. Established in 2004, the agency has delivered over 2,700 brand campaigns by combining deep consumer insight, powerful creativity, and strategic media outreach. Eggfirst offers expertise across digital advertising, mainstream creative, and celebrity integration, serving renowned brands that target “Bharat” consumers. Known for impactful rural campaigns and collaborations with leading celebrities, Eggfirst consistently sets industry benchmarks while contributing to rural India’s growth story through initiatives like the “Eggfirst Chalo Rural Conclave \& Awards.”
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Goregaon for a Junior Motion Graphic Designer \& Video Editor. The role involves creating motion graphics, editing videos, and designing visual content for digital and mainstream campaigns targeted at Tier 2/3 and rural audiences. Daily tasks include collaborating with the creative team on concepts, storyboards, and visual styles; producing short\-form and long\-form video content; and adapting graphics for multiple platforms such as social media, digital ads, and brand films. The Junior Motion Graphic Designer \& Video Editor will also assist in preparing assets for client presentations, optimizing videos for various formats, and maintaining brand consistency across projects.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Motion Design and Motion Graphics for digital and video\-led campaigns.
* Hands\-on experience in Video Production, including video editing and basic post\-production workflows.
* Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics creation for social media, digital ads, and other marketing materials.
* Working knowledge of industry\-standard tools (e.g., Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator or equivalent).
* Ability to interpret creative briefs, follow storyboards, and adapt visuals to diverse regional and rural audiences.
* Attention to detail, time management skills, and ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Design, Animation, Media, or a related field; prior internship or 0–2 years of experience in a similar role is preferred.
* Interest in rural and Tier 2/3 markets and willingness to learn about “Bharat” consumer behavior.
